ruleset.name: helios-test
ruleset.description: Complexity, size and coupling limits for Helios test code: pmd-main.xml minus the three class-level rules that do not fit test classes (cyclomatic complexity per class, God class, too many methods). Keep the two in step. The four rules at the end apply to test code only: they keep every test's outcome independent of real time.

rule.message: if statements are nested 3 or more deep (limit: a depth of 2)
The class has more than 15 non-static, non-final fields
The switch averages 10 or more statements per label (limit: fewer than 10)

rule.name: OnDemandImport
rule.message: On-demand (wildcard) imports are not allowed; import each type or static member by name.
rule.description: Every import names exactly one type or static member.

rule.name: SleepInTest
rule.message: A test does not sleep: wait for the event through com.standardapplied.helios.core.test.Await
rule.description: A test waits for an event, never for time.

rule.name: PipedStreamInTest
rule.message: A piped stream fails when its writer thread exits: use LineSink and FeedableInputStream from com.standardapplied.helios.core.test
rule.description: What the code under test writes goes to a LineSink; what it reads comes from a FeedableInputStream.

rule.name: ClockReadInTest
rule.message: A test does not measure elapsed time: assert the outcome
rule.description: A test never asserts how long something took.

rule.name: TimedWaitInTest
rule.message: A test does not choose its own timeout: wait through com.standardapplied.helios.core.test.Await, which applies the one hang guard
rule.description: A wait ends with the event or with the hang guard shared by every test.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit')] or (pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#join(_*)') and ArgumentList/*) or (pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Object#wait(_*)') and ArgumentList/*) or @MethodName = ('assertTimeout', 'assertTimeoutPreemptively')] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'Await'] and /CompilationUnit/PackageDeclaration[@Name = 'com.standardapplied.helios.core.test'])]
